id: 03_Safety Officer Interview Questions with Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions
title: 安全知识问答：实验室安全管理入门（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/03_Safety Officer Interview Questions with Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/03_Safety Officer Interview Questions with Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions（国内版）/src.py

points.S4: 应急设施要认得、找得到
points.S6: 事故后保护现场、配合调查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上放着一摞空白卡片，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a stack of blank cards and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天讲管理入门！
overlay: 安全知识问答：实验室安全管理入门

shots.scene: 老周把一个空白文件夹交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank folder to the female graduate student in the lab office.
shots.narration: 小研刚当上实验室安全员。

shots.scene: 小研打开文件夹，里面是一列问号卡片，她有点紧张
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the folder and sees a row of blank cards with question mark icons; she looks a little nervous.
shots.narration: 老周说：先把这些基本问题弄明白。

shots.scene: 欣欣从卡片后面探出头来
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pops up from behind the stack of cards and smiles.
shots.narration: 别慌，我陪你一题一题过。

shots.scene: 人、建筑、树三个图标外罩一层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, a building icon and a tree icon under one protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 安全：人不受伤，财产和环境不受损。

shots.scene: 小研在整洁的实验室里环顾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks around a tidy, well-lit laboratory and nods.
shots.narration: 远离会造成伤害的状况，才叫安全。

shots.scene: 实验室里各处浮现警示三角：碎玻璃、电线、热板
shots.prompt_en: Yellow warning triangles pop up around a lab: over broken glass in a bin, a frayed cable and a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：凡是可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 烫伤的手和割伤的手指图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand with a burn mark and an icon of a finger with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害：事故在身上留下的损伤。

shots.scene: 打翻的试剂瓶和倒下的小人图标，旁边有树和建筑图标
shots.prompt_en: A tipped-over reagent bottle icon and a fallen person pictogram, with a tree icon and a building icon nearby marked with red exclamation marks. No people.
shots.narration: 事故：没有计划的意外，造成损失或伤亡。

shots.scene: 高处架子上一只锤子掉落，砸在空地上，旁边小人完好
shots.prompt_en: A hammer falls from a high shelf and lands on an empty spot beside a person pictogram that is unharmed. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件：锤子掉了，没砸到人。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着地上的锤子图标，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the fallen hammer icon with a serious face.
shots.narration: 关键在于：它本来可能伤人。

shots.scene: 骰子图标乘以伤害图标等于仪表盘
shots.prompt_en: An equation of icons: a dice icon times an injury icon equals a gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险：被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 小研看着仪表盘指针在黄区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a gauge icon whose needle points into the yellow zone.
shots.narration: 常用可能性乘以后果来衡量。

shots.scene: 五个圆形图标：书、奖章、齿轮、法槌、放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Five round icons in a row: a book, a medal, a gear, a gavel and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 预防事故的五个E。

shots.scene: 王老师上安全课，台下学生举手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a lab safety class; students raise their hands.
shots.narration: 教育靠培训，激励靠表扬和奖励。

shots.scene: 老李安装通风设施，墙上挂着空白制度牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a ventilation duct while a blank rules board hangs on the wall.
shots.narration: 工程上防护，制度上严格执行。

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves over a blank checklist with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 最后评估效果，不断改进。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层，由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid in five colored layers from green at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制危害，按层级从上往下选。

shots.scene: 危险步骤图标被整个删除；高毒试剂换成低毒试剂
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a hazardous step card being removed entirely, and a bottle with a skull pictogram swapped for a bottle with a milder pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 能去掉就去掉，能替换就替换。

shots.scene: 通风柜图标和防护罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood and a protective guard over a stirrer. No people.
shots.narration: 再用工程措施，把人和危害隔开。

shots.scene: 空白作业许可单和空白规程卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank work permit form with a stamp icon next to a blank procedure card. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制：改进做法、定制度、办许可。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、实验服图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护，放在最后。

shots.scene: 杂乱的实验台变整洁的前后对比
shots.prompt_en: A before-and-after view of a messy lab bench becoming neat and organized. No people.
shots.narration: 5S，让实验室整洁有序。

shots.scene: 阿杰把不用的仪器配件放进回收箱，小研把瓶子按位摆好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts unused parts into a box while the female graduate student places bottles back in marked spots.
shots.narration: 清走不用的，常用的定点摆放。

shots.scene: 墙上的空白值日表打满勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank cleaning duty chart on the wall filled with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 天天清扫，定标准，养成习惯。

shots.scene: 老周在空白承诺书上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank commitment document at his desk.
shots.narration: 安全方针，是负责人的书面承诺。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：靶心、人像、齿轮
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards light up one by one: a target icon, a group of people icon and a gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 写清目标、各人职责、怎么落实。

shots.scene: 靶心图标中央是一个零字形的圆环
shots.prompt_en: A target icon whose bullseye is an empty ring, with an upward arrow of steady improvement beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 比如零事故的目标，并持续改进。

shots.scene: 空白计划书从承诺书图标中延伸出来
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan booklet extends from a commitment document icon with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 安全计划，把方针变成行动。

shots.scene: 任务卡片旁边逐一贴上危害标记和措施卡
shots.prompt_en: Task cards on a board each get a hazard marker and a blank control card pinned beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 逐项找危害，配上控制措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着空白规程手册，翻开是步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank procedure manual open to numbered step icons.
shots.narration: 标准操作规程：危险工作的书面步骤。

shots.scene: 几本不同颜色的规程手册，封面分别是气瓶、高压釜、离心机图标
shots.prompt_en: Several procedure binders with different colored covers showing icons of a gas cylinder, a pressure vessel and a centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 不同的危险操作，有不同的规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰照着仪器旁的规程卡一步步操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows a blank step card posted next to an instrument, checking each step.
shots.narration: 照规程做，不凭感觉。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five stairs each with an icon: a magnifying glass, a group of people, a scale, a notepad and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估，分五步走。

shots.scene: 高处架子上的工具图标，下方站着小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A tool icon on the edge of a high shelf with a person pictogram standing below it. No people.
shots.narration: 比如高处放东西，掉下来会砸到谁？

shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上填写，旁边是措施图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank assessment form; icons of a shelf guard and a moved box appear beside it.
shots.narration: 评估风险，定措施，并记录下来。

shots.scene: 换了新仪器、来了新同学、换了实验，三图标指向循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a new instrument, a new student and a new experiment card, all pointing to a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 人、设备、实验变了，都要重新评估。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准一张事故示意图
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a simple diagram of a tipped bottle and a slipping person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故调查，有三个目的。

shots.scene: 树根图标、扳手图标、法规书图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: tree roots, a wrench and a law book. No people.
shots.narration: 找根本原因，定纠正措施，满足法规。

shots.scene: 同一个事故图标被大大的禁止符号盖住
shots.prompt_en: The accident diagram icon is covered by a large prohibition symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 让同样的事故不再发生。

shots.scene: 会议桌两边人数相等，中间是盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A meeting table with the same number of seats on each side and a shield icon in the middle; the older man and the female graduate student sit on opposite sides.
shots.narration: 安全委员会：管理者和员工代表一起开。

shots.scene: 王老师主持，大家围着空白议程讨论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a meeting; the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank agenda.
shots.narration: 专门商量安全问题，大家都能发声。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三个图标相连
shots.prompt_en: Three linked building icons: a university building, a department building and a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 学校和学院，也有安全工作组织。

shots.scene: 实验室门上有门禁，旁边是空白证书图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with an access card reader and a blank certificate icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先过准入这一关。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前做安全考试，屏幕空白只有勾选框
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes an online safety exam on a computer; the screen shows only blank check boxes.
shots.narration: 参加培训，考试合格才能进。

shots.scene: 老周带阿杰熟悉实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks the young male student around the lab, pointing at equipment.
shots.narration: 进了实验室，还要接受专门培训。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表巡查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through a lab with a blank inspection checklist.
shots.narration: 安全检查：自查、学院查、学校查。

shots.scene: 检查表上一项打红圈，旁边贴上整改卡
shots.prompt_en: One item on the checklist gets a red circle and a blank correction card is pinned beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 查出隐患，定人、定时、定措施整改。

shots.scene: 整改前后对比：堵塞的通道变通畅
shots.prompt_en: Before-and-after icons: a blocked lab exit cluttered with boxes, then the same exit clear with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 整改完成，要复查确认。

shots.scene: 空白应急预案册和地图图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency plan booklet next to a floor map icon with exit arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室要有应急预案。

shots.scene: 大家按疏散箭头有序走向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man walk calmly along evacuation arrows toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 定期演练，出事时才不慌。

shots.section_title: 应急设施要认得、找得到
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和紧急喷淋标志
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign and an emergency shower sign on a lab wall above the equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、喷淋在哪，第一天就要认清。
overlay: 应急设施要认得、找得到

shots.section_title: 应急设施要认得、找得到
shots.scene: 灭火器、急救箱、紧急切断按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire extinguisher, a first aid kit and an emergency power off button. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、急救箱、电源总闸也一样。

shots.section_title: 应急设施要认得、找得到
shots.scene: 设施前面空空荡荡，被箱子挡住的被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an eyewash station with clear space in front with a green check, and one blocked by boxes crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前面不堆东西，随时能用。

shots.scene: 深夜空荡的实验室里一个人做实验，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a single person working alone in a dark empty lab at night, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验，不要一个人做。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰同在实验台前，一人操作一人看护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a bench while the young male student stands nearby watching.
shots.narration: 至少两人在场，互相照应。

shots.scene: 空白登记本和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank sign-in logbook next to a clock icon showing late hours. No people.
shots.narration: 非工作时间做实验，按规定报备。

shots.section_title: 事故后保护现场、配合调查
shots.scene: 事故现场周围拉起警戒线
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench area after a small incident with a barrier tape around it. No people.
shots.narration: 事故处置完，保护好现场。
overlay: 事故后保护现场、配合调查

shots.section_title: 事故后保护现场、配合调查
shots.scene: 小研向王老师说明经过，王老师记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains what happened while the safety administrator takes notes on a blank form.
shots.narration: 如实说明经过，配合调查。

shots.section_title: 事故后保护现场、配合调查
shots.scene: 空白报告单上出现勾和改进箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank report form with a check mark and an upward improvement arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 调查不是为了追责，是为了改进。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害、风险、事故、未遂四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons: a warning triangle, a gauge, a collision and a near-miss arrow.
shots.narration: 分清基本概念，是安全管理的起点。

shots.scene: 五个E图标和倒金字塔
shots.prompt_en: Five round icons and an inverted pyramid icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 五个E防事故，控制层级管危害。

shots.scene: 承诺书、计划书、规程手册三图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a commitment document, a plan booklet and a procedure manual. No people.
shots.narration: 方针定方向，计划和规程落到实处。

shots.scene: 五级台阶和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A five-step stair icon and a magnifying glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估再动手，出了事查原因。

shots.scene: 门禁、检查表、洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an access card reader, a checklist and an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 准入、检查、应急，一样都不能少。

shots.scene: 小研合上文件夹，欣欣和她一起向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the folder with a smile, and the panda mascot waves goodbye beside her.
shots.narration: 人人懂管理，实验更安全，再见！
